desc: If you have ever picked up an over and under shotgun and thought it was too heavy to take afield, the Citori Hunter Deluxe solves this conundrum. With a receiver scaled for 16 gauge, the Citori Hunter Deluxe is closer in weight to a 20 gauge, with a shot payload nearer the 12 gauge and patterning that bests them both. This beautiful shotgun is expertly appointed with Grade III/IV American walnut with a smooth gloss oil finish and an effective Inflex recoil pad for added shooting comfort. The receiver is treated with an elegantly tough silver nitride finish, and the barrels have a handsome polish blued finish. Game scene engraving on the receiver remind you that you're hunting with a Browning.
